description.en: Creates a temporary "guest" character (a one-off NPC companion for a specific cutscene, internally tagged SERVANT/Union and given the default RPGMain motion set) and returns its handle. Used for characters that accompany the player during a single event without being permanent party members.
Character base ID to spawn as the guest.
Optional body/costume model ID override for the guest.
Handle of the created guest character.

example.code:
// Spawn a temporary guest companion for this scene
local hShinsukeL = CMND_CREATE_GUEST_CHARA(0, 5, 902);
